notes.title: Crossbow: Bloodnight Controller Support Patch
notes.notes:
Improved Controller Support: 
- Players can now have multiple controllers connected to their PC and operate the game with any of them, without needing to restart the game 
- Fixed bug where players couldn't select the level with gamepad 
- Added button icons matching the controller (Xbox or PS)

notes.title: New & Upcoming Games
notes.notes:
[h1]Hyperstrangers![/h1]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/40157993/sale/DreamHackBeyondSummerIndieShowcase]Dreamhack Beyond[/url] is right around the corner, Dudes, and you guessed it - we are in it! However, this bit of news isn’t just about that. While you are keeping up with all news related to CROSSBOW: Bloodnight, we would like to showcase other things we have been cooking for your gaming pleasure!

[b]But, but, but... before these beauties will be ready to be injected into your veins, you gotta follow and wishlist[/b]. It makes the algorithm gods happy and jolts our developers’ hearts with joyful exuberance - whatever that means.


[h1]CosmoPirates[/h1]

Space, the final frontier, a place devoid of the tight-ass bureaucracy. A place where a man can cruise in their Fiat 126p, lick batteries, and be a self-made cosmonaut! Unless you get raided by pirates, poisoned by a hot-dog from an unlicensed food-shuttle or scammed by Kovalsky at the spaceship dealer. 

[b]CosmoPirates takes card battling, deck building to the final frontier of cartoonish comedy[/b]. Pimp-out your ride, gather your crew, and take out the cringeworthy overlord. [b]Be wary tho, for there always must be a Cringe lord - and on your journey you might just become one.[/b]

[previewyoutube=7rkDRQRCe2I;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Wishlist & Follow[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2466240/CosmoPirates/


[h1]NecroGolf[/h1]

There are some things that simply go great together although you wouldn’t think so: potatoes and pizza, mayo and ketchup or [b]Zombies and Golf[/b]! That’s right! There is nothing more riveting than trying to land a perfect birdie with a horde of the ravenous undead breathing down your neck.

In NecroGolf, [b]an arcade golf simulator with RPG elements and zombies, you can put your precision golfing to the test. NecroGolf releases in less than a month, on September 15th[/b], so make sure to wishlist it, grab your clubs and get in your golf cart, for in this zombie apocalypse, there is only golf.

[h3]Want to take a test swing? [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2330380/NecroGolf/]Check out the Demo![/url][/h3]
[h3]Want to see some new gameplay? Check out our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2330380/NecroGolf/]stream [/url]during Dreamhack Beyond![/h3]

[previewyoutube=CchLm5QoXck;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2330380/NecroGolf/


[h1]77p egg: Eggwife[/h1]

If you are in for even more Hyperstrangeness, [b]then embark in 77p egg: Eggwife on a quest whose crude, gory, toilet-humor can only be rivaled by games such as Postal 2, Duke 3D, or Goat Simulator.[/b] [b]Master your bodily functions to perform such feats as poop-jumping[/b] and employ a wide range of "UK-Legal'' weapons such as the Applicator, Crossbowner and Stigmatic 77,000!

Does this masterpiece have a story? Yes, and a relatable one at that. Building a stable relationship isn’t that easy and our protagonist will need your help on his quest to find a new wife! 

Unless he gets lost in the grocery aisle[b] again.[/b]

[previewyoutube=OXD0zCu0rJw;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Wishlist & Follow[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1317020/77p_egg_Eggwife/


[h1]EMPTY SHELL[/h1]

Let’s step down from the joyful sensory overload of the above mentioned games to something a little bit different. Something less strange and definitely more hyper.

[b]In Empty Shell, a top-down roguelite survival horror, you will get thrown into a secret facility on a Japanese island[/b]. Having signed a contract which stated only one condition “recover the designated target”, you will soon learn why it is so important to read the fine print.

During each run, you will try to get the “volunteer” through the facility while dealing with limited visibility, dwindling supplies and whatever is out there, stalking and hunting you throughout the randomized maze of tight-corridors. 

[h3]Wishlist the game! 
If you can't wait to play, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2243110/EMPTY_SHELL/]we have a prologue waiting for you[/url]![/h3]

[previewyoutube=itS2IVzAVbg;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2243110/EMPTY_SHELL/


[h1]Strategic Mind: Spirit of Liberty[/h1]

If you are peckish and looking for something more crunchy to stimulate your strategic mind, then look no further than Spirit of Liberty, [b]a hardcore, turn-based, historically accurate strategy game set in WWII. [/b]

Master the intricacies of the game’s systems to keep your units supplied and armed with the best equipment and dismantle enemy forces through combined-arms tactics and help from your cabinet of generals.

notes.title: POSTAL: Brain Damaged update, Blood West Chapter 2, Supplice release date, INCISION release, new games in the catalog, and more Realms Deep 2023 news from Hyperstrange
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38371631/1699b1f20e514af85e9d00ea02a216d728938311.png[/img]

[h1]Hyperstrangers![/h1]

It is [i]that[/i] time of the year again. Boomercon is upon us! Or Realms Deep 2022, if you will. We've had six announcements this year, so let's jump into it without further ado. This serves just as a summary - more detailed posts will be popping up on appropriate game pages within a day or two. Let's go!

[h2]INCISION - Early Acces launch + Special Offers![/h2]
[previewyoutube=qlgqps4wcbU;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1734680/INCISION/
Check out our nevest, explosive release! INCISION is a rare gem - a very retro-looking, unforgiving throwback shooter, that's so full of wonderfully-executed ideas, that it feels fresh and juicy. That is if you like your juice in the taste of rust, rot, and horror. The game launched on the day of Realms Deep main event - 16 September, and is already gaining a lot of praise from the players on Steam. If you like games such as DUSK, you can't afford to miss INCISION. And speaking of DUSK - DUSK owners get extra 15% off the price that's been already lowered by 15% in the release week. Similar discount applies for owners of Nightmare Reaper and Hedon, with even more bundles on the way! Get your tetanus shot, and plunge into the horror now!

[h2]POSTAL: Brain Damaged - Horde Mode announcement[/h2]
[previewyoutube=xoMT9iW_690;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359980/POSTAL_Brain_Damaged/
POSTAL: Brain Damaged has already gotten a small balancing update. Now, on September 19 it's getting another one. Much more substantial - it should help a lot with the balance between exploration and combat, thanks to the new ammo mechanics. Wait, that's not what you just saw in the video above? That's very perceptive! November 10 will mark the release of the Horde Mode in POSTAL: Brain Damaged, so you can spend even more time with the Brain Damaged Dude! 

[h2]Blood West - Chapter 2 announcement[/h2]
[previewyoutube=ll6tFR5ebg4;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1587130/Blood_West
Your favorite eerie wild west stealth-shooter with a bit of a immersive sim aftertaste has exceeded our initial expectations as to the reception and popularity. In wake of such success the Blood West team has been expanded, and the project was granted an extended development schedule, to deliver more content than it was originally intended. The second out of 3 chapters in the story of the Revenant Gunslinger will hit Steam on Halloween, and you'll be getting a map that's 1.5 larger and tighter packed with events and NPCs then the first one.

[h2]Supplice - release date announcement[/h2]
[previewyoutube=2YS2ZCjBTnw;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1693280/Supplice/
According to some sources, Supplice is the best-looking game in the entire Hyperstrange catalog. Well, beauty takes time! We've hold off making the announcement of the release date, to make sure Mekworx team has enough time to work their magic. Now, we're happy to announce the date you've been dying to know: [b]30 march 2023[/b]!

[h2]77p Egg: Eggwife - new game announcement[/h2]
[previewyoutube=OXD0zCu0rJw;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1317020/77p_egg_Eggwife/
We fell in love with Eggwife after first seeing it in the Realms Deep 2021 showcase. Now, after we've released POSTAL: Brain Damaged it's perfectly clear, that the audience wants us to take things a step further. Or a lot of steps further. To go so far, that we'll end up in UK. Eggwife is what would happen if the Brits came up with POSTAL, but... it's so much more. An immersive sim? A dating sim? A shopping cart driver sim? You name it! Maybe just go wishlist it, and get the Demo for you to plau

[h2]GHOSTWARE: Arena of the Dead - new game announcement[/h2]
[previewyoutube=qAiV6YUVacM;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1893370/GHOSTWARE_Arena_of_the_Dead/
We strive to bring overlooked, original titles to a broader audience. Sometimes originality isn't apparent at face value. What seems like an arena shooter with retro stylings happens to become a whole sprawling world full of adventure and danger. You can find out for yourself just what makes Ghostware so unique that it found its way to our hearts. We'e not sure of the release date yet with this one, but we do highly encourage you to wishlist it and take the available demo for a spin.

And that's that. We'll be happy to hear your thoughts on our Hyperstrange Discord, steam forums, and clay tablets. Thank you for being a part of the Hyperstrange crowd, and Stay Metal!

[h2]Your's truly,[/h2]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38371631/0703e4c0718a8efe5be90b59356042bc0910a9e2.png[/img]

notes.title: POSTAL: Brain Damaged - Connoisseur Edition (OST & Art Book bundle!) + upcoming updates!
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38371631/fbb0539e05676ff94aa2b21c71c2b025479b62c1.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hyperstrange friends, RWS fam![/h1]

Hyperstrange-developed [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359980/POSTAL_Brain_Damaged/]POSTAL: Brain Damaged[/url], the action-packed DOOM Eternal-like spin-off of the POSTAL series is finally here, and  if you own any of the eligible RWS or Hyperstrange titles, or some other staple throwback-shooters like DUSK, Hedon, or Nightmare Reaper, you can get PBD with an additional discount added on top of -20% release discount [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359980/POSTAL_Brain_Damaged/][b]via one of the special bundle deals[/b][/url].

Plus, we're happy to report it really SLAPS! With more than 1100 reviews it currently enjoys an 'Overwhelmingly Positive' rating, with more than 95% players recommending the game.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38371631/18684ae3b765836c7dde86fa69ffe2737dfcac06.gif[/img]

Yes, Hyperstrange really pulled this one off. The game is good and the release has been relatively bug-free despite the 2-week delay made explicitly to implement some bugs and stay on-brand. But it wouldn't be a POSTAL release if something haven't gone wrong. Many of you were waiting for the release of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359980/POSTAL_Brain_Damaged/]POSTAL: Brain Damaged Official Soundtrack[/url]. The wait is finally over! The OST has arrived, and you can get it separately or bundled with the official Art Book in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/26678/POSTAL_Brain_Damaged__Connoisseur_Edition][b]POSTAL: Brain Damaged - Connoisseur Edition[/b][/url].

[previewyoutube=q7UXDk9xsaM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]UPCOMING UPDATES[/h1]

The Hyperstrange Dev team is very grateful for the amazing reception of PBD. This gives them even more motivation to improve and expand the game post-release. Here's what to expect soon:

[list]
[*] [b]Post-release fix [/b]- an update taking care of the known issues reported by the players, that slipped into the full release (ETA: One week)
[*] [b]Balancing update[/b] - some players, as well as [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ld5VPBIQeSM]some internet micro-celebrities[/url], have brought to our attention that the game offers way to much ammo if you explore the levels 'Quake-style', and far too little if you prefer to push on 'Doom Eternal-style'. The update will take care of that issue, allowing everyone to enjoy the game in their preferred playstyle. The update will also reconfigure some of the enemy positioning, spawns, and behavior. (ETA: One month)
[*] [b]New playmodes[/b] - With that taken care of, the dev team will proceed to expanding the game itself, introducing an oft-requested horde mode, as well as another playmode offering a new, and replayable PBD experience. (ETA: This summer)
[*] [b]More to be announced![/b]
[/list]

Hyperstrange and RWS are both extremely pleased with the reception of [b]POSTAL: Brain Damaged[/b]. We're as excited as you are, to see what the future will bring to this explosive and twisted spin-off.

[b]Your true friends and family,[/b]
[h2]Hyperstrange & RWS[/h2]

notes.title: The spooky Steam Cards and other community items arrive! + Competition
notes.notes:
[h2]Covenants![/h2]

This is a small update, but one that makes us really proud. A game on Steam needs to pass a certain threshold of player engagement - build up enough presence, so to speak - to be granted the option to offer community items such as Steam Cards, profile backgrounds, or emotes. While [b]CROSSBOW: Bloodnight[/b] remains a rather niche title, a treat for players with a very specific taste in arena shooters, we've managed to grow our community enough to be granted the privilige.

So, it's our utmost pleasure this Halloween season, to introduce to you our collection of community items!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38715248/5321e55cc1a900ee42362c27503cafb400f7040d.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38715248/403cdcb8a796bf94d0f017147fd47ecf78a34bd4.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38715248/1461eb12dda0f8bf37e07c39a4ae8f109b646d17.png[/img]

That's just 3 out of the 5 cards, that you can convert to a badge. We hope you'll get some extra fun from collecting all those lil abominations.

[h2]Win our newest game![/h2]

If you're here, it's fair to assume you enjoy fast-paced FPS action. Just days ago, we've released our newest game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1689190/RAYZE/][i][b]RAYZE[/b][/i][/url]. This passion-project developed by a small splinter-team, partially on a break from our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359980/POSTAL_Brain_Damaged/][i][b]POSTAL: Brain Damaged[/b][/i][/url] development. What is RAYZE? 

[previewyoutube=RShRa8NRCUo;full][/previewyoutube]

RAYZE is an Aim Racer, a simplistic FPS game focusing on accuracy and reaction time, much like aim training apps, but making the whole process into an actual game. Already enjoying strong following from the FPS speedrunning community, it presents quite a challenge to the player. And we know CROSSBOW players do enjoy a challenge. We heartily invite you to check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1689190/RAYZE/][i][b]RAYZE[/b][/i][/url] while it's in the final hours of its release promo. If you own CROSSBOW: Bloodnight and ELDERBORN, you can get it even cheaper by completing our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/23043/The_Action_Hyperpack/][b]Action Hyper-Pack Bundle[/b][/url]. 

But there's also a simple (not to be mistaken with [i]easy[/i]) [b]way for you to get RAYZE free[/b]. Everyone who records a CROSSBOW: Bloodnight run with a time of 666 seconds or greater and uploads it to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1329540/videos/]video section[/url] of the CROSSBOW: Bloodnight community hub [b]before Tuesday, November 2, 12am PST[/b], will receive a free copy of RAYZE on Steam! [i]Make sure that the player nickname is visible in the video (eg. in the leaderboards) and that it matches the one you use on steam, so we can avoid any fake claims easily.[/i]

Good luck, hunters!

PS. One more thing! Please remember to toggle that Halloween mode ON in the game's settings:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38715248/738f87615eda2d45d64b3ea9d7821ff89b70b020.gif[/img]
Sure, you can have Halloween all year-long in [b]CROSSBOW: Bloodnight[/b],  but this is the season when it seems just obligatory. 

[i][b]Thank you, good hunting, and happy Halloween![/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38715248/27d400d666972d746cafe23f07e33a1b9db61f11.png[/img]

notes.title: Thank you for an amazing Steam Next Fest 2021, folks! We're keeping all the demos for you to play longer!
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38371631/8215daa0ebcca22bfc64465d6831bd30c2ba0ede.png[/img]

As [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] draws to a conclusion we want to thank everyone for stopping by and trying out our demos. We've had tens of thousands people playing the featured games, hundreds joining our [b][url=https://discord.gg/AqQ5Cc8UkA]community Discord[/url][/b] to offer feedback, and posting on social media! 

Many of you have been asking "will I be able to keep playing the demo after Next Fest ends"? Steam suggests all Next Fest demos should be timed, to create a sense of urgency and make sure the players wishlist the game. But this is simply not the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/pub/Hyperstrange]Hyperstrange[/url][/b] way. We're old enough (well, some of us) to remember shareware times, when demos came on floppies and lasted forever (well, some of them). Cutting to the chase: the demos stay, at least until their respective games get released. Here's what you can play, in case you missed some of them:

[h1]RAYZE[/h1]
[previewyoutube=lsYO7QOS6aE;full][/previewyoutube]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1689190/RAYZE][b]RAYZE[/b][/url]  is a genre-defying hyper-paced music-filled first-person AIM RACER. Hit a target to accelerate. Miss and you slow down. Hit a wall and die. Find the fastest route. Get to the finish line. Simple? Yes. Easy? Hell no. Who said training to be your own aim-bot can't be fun? Welcome to your new casually hardcore obsession!

The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1689190/RAYZE][b]DEMO[/b][/url] consists of the entire first sector of the game, that's 5 tracks for you to figure out and master, one bite-size FPS speedrun at a time. Achievements to unlock, global leaderboards to compete with friends and strangers... Just two more weeks until full release! Ready? 3... 2... 1... Let's RAYZE!

[h1]Blood West[/h1]
[previewyoutube=hnr5wWsnJ6w;full][/previewyoutube]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1587130/Blood_West][b]BLOOD WEST[/b][/url], an immersive Wild West FPS where a revenant desperado takes on the twisted demons and eldritch horros in a cursed, desolate mining town. Hell is empty and all the devils are here! Plan your steps, be stealthy, gain advantage, manage your resources, and paint the world dark red! Blood West was the second most-played Hyperstrange demo in Steam Fest, and there's already many players telling us they cannot wait for the release, despite the game being brutally hard! If you missed the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1587130/Blood_West][b]DEMO[/b][/url], you can still try, and if you like the experience of being the Revenant desperado, please [b]remember to add the game to your wishlist[/b]!

[h1]Supplice[/h1]
[previewyoutube=03gC5zFgKk0;full][/previewyoutube]
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1693280/Supplice]Supplice[/url][/b] is a stylish throwback shooter that made a lot of people happy during the Steam Next Fest. inspired by the mid-90s FPS glory days and the legendary Doom modding community. Mixing the retro stylings of 90s era shooters with colorful graphics and frantic gameplay, it creates an experience that's ever so familiar but also exciting and fresh. The team behind the game is a real hot pot of Doom modding and FPS development legends, starting from Brett 'Mechadon' Harrell, the project founder, through Aleksander 'Cage' Kowalczyk, the lead artist also known for his work with [i]Ion Fury[/i], to James 'Jimmy' Paddock, the lead composer, known from his midi soundtracks to Sigil, Prodeus, and many other talents. Please check out the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1693280/Supplice][b]DEMO[/b][/url] and follow & add the game to your wishlist if you want to stay up to date with its development.

[h1]Skullstone[/h1]
[previewyoutube=ias1aZwsHRU;full][/previewyoutube]
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1693290/Skullstone]Skullstone[/url][/b] is a true to its form dungeon crawler with grid-based movement, real-time tactics combat, and first-person view. Lead a party of adventurers into the under-realm, looking for glory, gold, and a solution to the ancient evil plaguing the town above. A real stand-out in the FPS action-focused Hyperstrange catalog - why not give it some appreciation by playing the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1693290/Skullstone][b]DEMO[/b][/url] and wishlisting this pure-blooded classic RPG.


[h1]POSTAL: Brain Damaged[/h1]
[previewyoutube=aSEnsSkkRRs;full][/previewyoutube]
Last, but in no way the least in our Steam Next Fest lineup, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359980/POSTAL_Brain_Damaged][b]POSTAL: Brain Damaged[/b][/url] dominated the First-Person Shooter category, reaping the most wishlists and getting over 20 000 demo downloads. If by some strange twist of fate you're here but you don't know what is POSTAL: Brain Damaged... it's a spin-off of the Running With Scissors cult series, firmly rooted in the POSTALVERSE, but taking more gameplay cues from modern shooters such as the latest DOOM, than the fan-acclaimed POSTAL 4, the latest entry in the main series. This time around the story follows POSTAL DUDE on a journey through the dark and bizarre landscape of his own mind, which gives the developer a chance to explore new depths of weirdness, madness, and gore. The gloves are off! See for yourself - play the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359980/POSTAL_Brain_Damaged][b]DEMO[/b][/url] and make sure to hit that wishlist button hard! [i](Please note that as we focus on developing the game, we won't be able to update the demo, so it will reflect the state of development in September 2021, even if you play it in May 2022, when the game is getting released. Expect improvements and changes!)[/i]

As we wrap-up the event, we feel immensely grateful to the wonderful Steam player community who show us so much appreciation. Please keep your feedback coming - if you have any to offer, please join our [b][url=https://discord.gg/AqQ5Cc8UkA]community Discord[/url][/b]. We strive to make your live stranger and filled to the brim with good old action, and it's such a rush to see that you enjoy what we bring to your screens. That is it for today,[b] be excellent to each other![/b]

[b]Yours truly,[/b]

notes.title: Jupiter Hell joins Hyperstrange catalog
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/811320/Jupiter_Hell][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38371631/573c241c88153dfe189a38d3f461dacaaffab242.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Enjoyed our Soulslike Doom? Now try Roguelike Doom![/h1]

At Hyperstrange, we strongly believe that badass games should stick together. That's why we've teamed up with ChaosForge to bring their [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/811320/Jupiter_Hell]Jupiter Hell[/url][/b] out of Early Access and into your black, brutal hearts. This spiritual successor to fan favorite Doom, the Roguelike (a free game later renamed to DRL, for obvious copyright reasons) is a Metal AF game and we've been its great fans for years before taking on the role of its publisher.

[url=https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38371631/bb519fdeeddfc8930202b16fcdfc4f9754f53d9d.png][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38371631/72beeb80c370cec8a448e0a3b73aa0b5b2428c53.png[/img][/url] [url=https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38371631/ba8a50a9c9c621ee33a2ca6bf9021badd3b328cc.png][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38371631/934e2f9647b28da482b05a320e7e080727c98ae7.png[/img][/url] [url=https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38371631/261d4bc9f6bdd5e87d2aec951894bf0000e40e10.png][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38371631/209349dce6d30667bb1a83e243859f6b625374b3.png[/img][/url] [url=https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38371631/72e84f587e26f55458fea38fc75b17457ad7264d.png][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38371631/d41f08d58b7ae5f1b1d20e0a07e92e4bc2886356.png[/img][/url]

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/811320/Jupiter_Hell]Jupiter Hell[/url][/b]  takes the classic, turn-based roguelike gameplay and puts it in a detailed and dynamic 3D, 90s flavored sci-fi environment. Jupiter Hell stays true to the staple qualities of the roguelike genre: procedural level generation, providing endless possibilities for another run, character permadeath, and brutal, yet fair difficulty level.

Make no mistake - this game is special. When it was doing its rounds on Kickstarter, it became the very first gamedev project backed by John Carmack. It also cought the eye of XCOM's designer, Jake Solomon. Then came Fallout's Brian Fargo and backed it as well. They all got their copies on August 1st, 2018, when Jupiter Hell launched in Early Access. It's retained a 'very positive' review score ever since, and it spawned a large community of dedicated players, who frequent the game's [b][url=https://discord.gg/jupiterhell]Discord[/url][/b].

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38371631/26fe4f09234cf7206d528dc872c1fa589f3bf436.gif[/img]

We're hyped as hell to stand side by side with ChaosForge and announce the date of  [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/811320/Jupiter_Hell]Jupiter Hell's[/url][/b] full release: August 5, 2021. The game just received a major update and is currently available 20% off if you don't want to wait that long. Go grab it, or wishlist it and get it in August.

[b]May RNG forever be in your favor![/b]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38371631/004e98061256dda3ac95738fd8db13a87798daef.png[/img]

notes.title: Your perfect Halloween game gets even better!
notes.notes:
[h2]Covenants![/h2]

'Tis the season, everyone. Brace yourselves. The veil between the worlds is lifting. It's Halloween, the time for [b]CROSSBOW: Bloodnight[/b] to truly shine! The game was already perfect to get you in the festive mood, with all the bats, zombies, and werewolves haunting the creepy old abbey courtyard. But we wouldn't be [b][url=http://steampowered.com/pub/hyperstrange]Hyperstrange[/url][/b], if we didn't take all the player feedback and put in some extra work to make our game - even as small as CROSSBOW: Bloodnight - even better. We give you the first post-release update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38715248/d1420c32859aa6646eb2bf82b487e7ff1a521628.png[/img]

[h2]CHANGELOG[/h2]

[list]
[*] all around asset optimization, both characters and environments - the game now runs much smoother, even on lower-end machines
[*] optimized bat swarm behavior for better performance
[*] when crossbow is at max upgrade level, lost souls decrease special attack cooldown on pick-up
[*] the enemy spawn loop altered after the boss fight, to avoid repeating the initial phase
[*] the further you are in the game, the higher enemy spawn rate gets
[*] spikes spawned on boss death only kill monsters now, not the player
[*] the Tainted One hitbox activates only when it's fully spawned
[*] npc sound effects should stand out more now
[*] seasonal Halloween decorations (they will go away with time...)
[/list]

Many thanks to everyone who picked up the game upon its launch and provided us with their thoughts on the gameplay, and ideas for improvements. The many thousands of players who got their hands on our ELDERBORN in early access or upon the full release already know, that we like to polish our games further after launch. We're looking forward to the same scenario for CROSSBOW: Bloodnight, and it's YOU who make it possible, giving us feedback and recommending the game to friends. We're really grateful to have you guys in our corner!

Thank you, good hunting, and happy Halloween!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38715248/91d6be19b6fe4063c048e62c0a398709bafaf311.png[/img]

notes.title: The hunt begins on September 24
notes.notes:
[h2]Hunters![/h2]

The Bloodnight is almost upon us. Next Thursday, September 24, Hyperstrange will put an arcane crossbow in your hands, and set loose a bunch of nightmare creatures against you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38715248/1d95d215c6f77c96442168263a255c33609c510b.gif[/img]

[b]What is CROSSBOW: Bloodnight?[/b]

Fluid movement, versatile weapon, global leaderboards - a small, neat package of challenging fun wrapped up in bat giblets, warewolf fur, and twitching tentacles. What's not to love? We're dropping that gruesome bundle of joy on Steam for only $2.99, and in the launch-week we're bringing the price even lower, to $1.99 tier.

[b]Why such a low price?[/b]

As recently announced, we are the developer of [b]POSTAL: Brain Damaged[/b], a boomer-core spin-off of Running With Scissors' POSTAL series. Our previous game - [b]ELDERBORN[/b] - was a strictly melee title. CROSSBOW: Bloodnight is a frantic score-attack arena shooter that takes the brilliant Devil Daggers concept and puts it in a detailed gothic horror, Painkiller-esque setting. It's  our way of saying 'hi!' to all of you boomer shooter fans, and we're practically giving it away to make sure we get to as many of you as we can!

Please wishlist & follow the game, so you get notified of its release.

[h2]Good hunting![/h2]
